title: Regression to mean
note: Most extreme performance windows revert. The 'hot streak' is a real psychological phenomenon but it's also a statistical artifact of selecting on outcomes. Aurora can flag the streak; only opponent-context and matchup-conditional analysis distinguish real form change from a run of favourable variance.

title: Fatigue is a calendar phenomenon
note: Modern rest-management theory treats fatigue as primarily a function of rolling minutes and back-to-back game density rather than the individual-game performance. The leading indicator surfaces in the schedule, not the box score; cross-reference any flagged underperformance with rest days.
